data.title: Saudi U-17 Team Prepares to Face France in Second World Cup Group Match
data.content:
Doha, November 21, 2026, SPA -- The Saudi Arabia U-17 national team will face France tomorrow, Sunday, in its second group-stage match at the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026 in Doha.
    Kick-off is set for 4:30 p.m. at Pitch 5 of Aspire Academy.
    The team held a training session on Saturday evening under the supervision of national coach Ahmed Al-Hanfoosh and his technical staff, featuring fitness drills, tactical exercises, and set-piece practice.
    Saudi Arabia is competing in Group D alongside France, Uruguay, and Haiti.
    -- SPA
